title: Calligraphy L0-02 · ‎ي‎ e ‎و: consonants, long vowels, diphthongs

blocks.text: Calligraphy L0-02 · ⁧ي⁩ and ⁧و⁩ : consonants, long vowels, diphthongs
⁧ي⁩ yāʾ · y / ī · /j/, [iː] Near palatale; after kasra marks the ī Long. Two points below.
⁧و⁩ wāw · w / ū · /w/, [uː] Nearby labiovelar; after ḍamma marks the ū Long. It's not connected to the next one.
